name: 53122 · Elm Grove, WI
findings: ZIP 53122 (Elm Grove) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53122 (Elm Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53122 (Elm Grove) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
